race.comment: PRIVATE MAX (1) brings the strongest exposed form, with two seconds from as many runs this campaign. He's scratched from a later race to run here and this looks a very winnable race on his last start effort. Can go one better this time around. TENDUE'S SPIRIT (3) has improved through the campaign and was third at Murwillumbah after being steadied near the 400m, with the 3kg claim helping offset the quick return. GOSLING (5) also comes through Murwillumbah, where he was third after beginning slowly, and the weight relief gives him a realistic place-to-win platform if he handles the extra ground. SEA TURTLE (7) has the most established placing record of the remaining chances and his Coffs Harbour second had merit given he was slow away and checked near the 1000m, though he has yet to place from repeated tries around this distance. ARABIAN LEGACY (4) is next best.
